title: Meetily: free Granola alternative
caption:
Granola charges $14/month. Meetily takes notes in your meetings for free 📝

✅ Live transcript, right on your own computer
✅ One-click meeting summaries
✅ Works offline and records your mic plus the call audio
✅ No subscription, nothing sent to the cloud

💻 Mac (Apple Silicon) · Windows · Linux (build from source)
ℹ️ Summaries use a free local model (Ollama) or your own AI key, and there's a separate paid Meetily PRO with extras.

Comment "NOTES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #productivity #meetings #ai #privacy #freeapps #techtips
dm_pitch: Meetily, the free open-source AI meeting note-taker and Granola alternative 📝
